grammar.pattern: 刚 / 刚刚 / 还 / 忽然 / 一直 / 已经
grammar.purpose: Locate a change without pretending the journey is finished
grammar.explanation: 刚/刚刚 place an event in the recent past; 已经 says it has happened by now. 还 can say a state continues: 还在路上. 一直 describes continuation across the stated period, not literally every moment forever. 忽然 describes a sudden change. Compare 我刚出发、我已经出发 and 我还没到: departure is not arrival. Use a location update instead of inventing an arrival time.

examples.py: wǒ gāng chū fā , péng you gāng gāng dào .
examples.en: I have just set off; my friend has just arrived.

examples.zh: 朋友已经到了，我还在路上。
examples.py: péng you yǐ jīng dào le , wǒ hái zài lù shàng .
examples.en: My friend has already arrived; I am still on the way.

examples.zh: 我一直在站台等，车忽然停了。
examples.py: wǒ yì zhí zài zhàn tái děng , chē hū rán tíng le .
examples.en: I have been waiting at the stop all along; the vehicle suddenly stopped.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我已经出发了，所以我已经到了。
commonMistakes.right: 我已经出发了，但还没到。
commonMistakes.why: Having departed does not entail having arrived.

grammar.pattern: 才 / 都 / 就 / 正好
grammar.purpose: Read the speaker’s expectation, not just the clock
grammar.explanation: 才六点四十 can mean only six forty, earlier than expected; 七点才到 means not arriving until seven, later than expected. 都七点了 expresses that seven is already late in this context. 就三个人 limits the group to only three people; 正好三个人 says exactly the needed three. These words express an expectation or fit. They do not change the factual time or headcount. Context decides whether a time feels early or late.

examples.py: cái liù diǎn sì shí , bù yòng jí .
examples.en: It is only six forty; no need to hurry.

examples.zh: 都七点了，他七点才到，大家已经等了一会儿。
examples.py: dōu qī diǎn le , tā qī diǎn cái dào , dà jiā yǐ jīng děng le yī huì er .
examples.en: It is already seven; he did not arrive until seven and everyone has already waited a while.

examples.zh: 今天就三个人，三个座位正好。
examples.py: jīn tiān jiù sān gè rén , sān gè zuò wèi zhèng hǎo .
examples.en: Today there are only three people; three seats are exactly enough.

commonMistakes.wrong: 正好三个人，所以一定有四个人。
commonMistakes.right: 正好三个人，没有第四个人。
commonMistakes.why: 正好三个人 gives an exact fit of three, not a fourth person.

grammar.purpose: Say that the time for an action has come
grammar.explanation: 该出发了 says it is time to depart now; 该走了 can gently close a visit. It does not say departure already happened. Compare 我们已经出发了. A time-related 该…了 is different from a general obligation 你应该看通知. Give the relevant plan when asking someone to act; urgency is not permission to ignore safety.

examples.zh: 集合时间到了，我们该出发了。
examples.py: jí hé shí jiān dào le , wǒ men gāi chū fā le .
examples.en: The meeting time has come; it is time for us to set off.

examples.py: tiān wǎn le , gāi huí jiā le .
examples.en: It is late; it is time to go home.

examples.zh: 该发消息了，还没有发出去。
examples.py: gāi fā xiāo xī le , hái méi yǒu fā chū qù .
examples.en: It is time to send the message; it has not gone through yet.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我们该出发了，就是我们已经到了。
commonMistakes.right: 我们该出发了，但还没有出发。
commonMistakes.why: Time to depart is not evidence that the journey is completed.

dialogue.title: A delay update
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the actual location and the next agreed update.

lines.zh: 都七点了，你到了吗？
lines.py: dōu qī diǎn le , nǐ dào le ma ?
lines.en: It is already seven; have you arrived?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没到。我六点出发，坐公共汽车。现在还在车上。
lines.py: hái méi dào . wǒ liù diǎn chū fā , zuò gōng gòng qì chē . xiàn zài hái zài chē shàng .
lines.en: Not yet. I set off at six by bus and am still on the vehicle now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 快点儿，我们已经等了一会儿。
lines.py: kuài diǎnr , wǒ men yǐ jīng děng le yī huì er .
lines.en: Hurry a little; we have already waited a while.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我有点儿急，但不能让司机开快。今天交通不顺利。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér jí , dàn bù néng ràng sī jī kāi kuài . jīn tiān jiāo tōng bù shùn lì .
lines.en: I am anxious, but I cannot ask the driver to speed up. Traffic is not going smoothly today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怎么了？
lines.py: zěn me le ?
lines.en: What happened?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 车忽然停了。司机说路口的车辆很多，这辆公交车可能要改道。
lines.py: chē hū rán tíng le . sī jī shuō lù kǒu de chē liàng hěn duō , zhè liàng gōng jiāo chē kě néng yào gǎi dào .
lines.en: It suddenly stopped. The driver says there are many vehicles at the intersection and this bus may need a different route.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 到学校的站了吗？
lines.py: dào xué xiào de zhàn le ma ?
lines.en: Have you reached the school stop?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没有。刚经过学校，没停车。车还没到那个站。
lines.py: hái méi yǒu . gāng jīng guò xué xiào , méi tíng chē . chē hái méi dào nà gè zhàn .
lines.en: Not yet. We just passed the school without stopping. The vehicle has not reached that stop.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 停车场那边近吗？你在那里下吧。
lines.py: tíng chē chǎng nà biān jìn ma ? nǐ zài nà lǐ xià ba .
lines.en: Is the car park nearby? Get off there.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 停车场不是站台，我先等到车停好再下。离学校近，也不能在路边下。
lines.py: tíng chē chǎng bù shì zhàn tái , wǒ xiān děng dào chē tíng hǎo zài xià . lí xué xiào jìn , yě bù néng zài lù biān xià .
lines.en: The car park is not the stop; I will wait until the vehicle stops properly before getting off. Being near the school does not mean I can get off at the roadside.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那该什么时候再问你？
lines.py: nà gāi shén me shí hou zài wèn nǐ ?
lines.en: Then when should I ask again?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 手机信号不好。我看手表了，但到达时间还没确认。时间一确认，我一定发消息。
lines.py: shǒu jī xìn hào bù hǎo . wǒ kàn shǒu biǎo le , dàn dào dá shí jiān hái méi què rèn . shí jiān yī què rèn , wǒ yí dìng fā xiāo xī .
lines.en: The phone signal is poor. I checked my watch, but the arrival time is unconfirmed. Once it is confirmed, I will definitely message.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A location update and a promise to message once confirmed
questions.answer: A location update and a promise to message once confirmed

questions.q: Is passing the school the same as reaching its stop?
choices: No, the bus passed without stopping
Yes, the traveller is already inside the school
Yes, the bus is at the car park
questions.answer: No, the bus passed without stopping

reading.title: Still on the bus
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to distinguish departure, passing a place and actual arrival.

lines.zh: 我六点出发，七点还在公共汽车上。朋友已经到了，我还没到。
lines.py: wǒ liù diǎn chū fā , qī diǎn hái zài gōng gòng qì chē shàng . péng you yǐ jīng dào le , wǒ hái méi dào .
lines.en: I set off at six and am still on the bus at seven. My friend has already arrived; I have not.

lines.zh: 刚才车忽然停了。司机说交通不顺利，路口的车辆很多。
lines.py: gāng cái chē hū rán tíng le . sī jī shuō jiāo tōng bù shùn lì , lù kǒu de chē liàng hěn duō .
lines.en: The vehicle suddenly stopped just now. The driver says traffic is not going smoothly and there are many vehicles at the intersection.

lines.zh: 这辆公交车刚经过学校，没有在那里停车。经过学校不是到站，更不是进学校。
lines.py: zhè liàng gōng jiāo chē gāng jīng guò xué xiào , méi yǒu zài nà lǐ tíng chē . jīng guò xué xiào bù shì dào zhàn , gèng bù shì jìn xué xiào .
lines.en: This bus just passed the school without stopping there. Passing the school is not reaching the stop, much less entering the school.

lines.zh: 我有点儿急。朋友说快点儿，我还是先看安全，不让司机开快。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér jí . péng you shuō kuài diǎnr , wǒ hái shi xiān kàn ān quán , bù ràng sī jī kāi kuài .
lines.en: I am anxious. My friend says to hurry, but I still prioritize safety and do not ask the driver to speed up.

lines.zh: 停车场离学校近，但停车场不是公交站。我等到车停好才下，不在路边下。
lines.py: tíng chē chǎng lí xué xiào jìn , dàn tíng chē chǎng bù shì gōng jiāo zhàn . wǒ děng dào chē tíng hǎo cái xià , bù zài lù biān xià .
lines.en: The car park is near the school but is not the bus stop. I wait until the vehicle stops properly to get off, not by the roadside.

lines.zh: 我一直没有离开车。站台的位置还要看清楚，不能只看距离近。
lines.py: wǒ yì zhí méi yǒu lí kāi chē . zhàn tái de wèi zhì hái yào kàn qīng chǔ , bù néng zhǐ kàn jù lí jìn .
lines.en: I have not left the vehicle all this time. I still need to check where the stop is; a short distance is not enough.

lines.zh: 看手表，已经七点了。手机信号不好，第一条消息可能没有发出去。
lines.py: kàn shǒu biǎo , yǐ jīng qī diǎn le . shǒu jī xìn hào bù hǎo , dì yī tiáo xiāo xī kě néng méi yǒu fā chū qù .
lines.en: My watch says it is already seven. The phone signal is poor, so the first message may not have gone through.

lines.zh: 到达时间还没确认，我不说一定七点到。时间一确认，就发消息。
lines.py: dào dá shí jiān hái méi què rèn , wǒ bù shuō yí dìng qī diǎn dào . shí jiān yī què rèn , jiù fā xiāo xī .
lines.en: The arrival time is unconfirmed, so I do not claim I will definitely arrive at seven. I will send a message once it is confirmed.

choices: Departure, location, arrival and an uncertain estimate
questions.answer: Departure, location, arrival and an uncertain estimate

questions.q: Where is the traveller at seven?
Does sending the first message prove it was delivered?
choices: No, poor signal leaves delivery uncertain
Yes, every phone always sends instantly
Yes, the traveller has already arrived
questions.answer: No, poor signal leaves delivery uncertain
